title: The Lord's Judgment on Jerusalem Because of Manasseh
description: The Lord declares through Jeremiah that even Moses or Samuel could not turn His heart away from the people. Some are destined for death, sword, famine, or captivity, and four kinds of punishment will strike them: sword, dogs, birds, and wild animals. Because of King Manasseh's deeds in Jerusalem, the city becomes a horror to all the kingdoms of the earth; widows become more numerous than the sand of the sea, and she who bore seven children withers away [ref:Jer 15:1-9|Jeremiah 15:1-9].
